children.title: Q1 Fiscal 2027 Summary
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 CFO Commentary.pdf/Root/CFO Commentary on First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results/Q1 Fiscal 2027 Summary
children.summary: This page presents the CFO Commentary on NVIDIA's First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results. It features three tables detailing financial performance: GAAP and Non-GAAP summaries (including revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, income, net income, and earnings per share) compared across Q1 FY27, Q4 FY26, and Q1 FY26. A third table breaks down revenue by reportable segments (Compute & Networking and Graphics).

children.title: Revenue
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 CFO Commentary.pdf/Root/CFO Commentary on First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results/Revenue
children.summary: The section details the company's financial performance for the first quarter, reporting a record total revenue of $81.6 billion, which represents an 85% increase year-over-year and a 20% increase sequentially. It breaks down this growth by market platform: Data Center revenue reached a record $75.2 billion (up 92% YoY), driven by Blackwell 300 products and InfiniBand/Spectrum-X/NVLink solutions; Edge Computing revenue was $6.4 billion (up 29% YoY), fueled by workstation demand but tempered by slower PC sales. The text also provides context on the new reporting framework transitioning to two main platforms (Data Center and Edge Computing) with specific sub-market definitions.

children.title: Gross Margin
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 CFO Commentary.pdf/Root/CFO Commentary on First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results/Gross Margin
children.summary: The 'Gross Margin' section explains that GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins for the first quarter increased year-over-year due to lower inventory provisions, specifically a $4.5 billion charge from the prior year related to H20 excess inventory. It notes that margins remained approximately flat sequentially as the Blackwell architecture continues to constitute the majority of revenue.

children.title: Expenses
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 CFO Commentary.pdf/Root/CFO Commentary on First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results/Expenses
children.summary: The section details the company's GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses for the first quarter, noting a 52% year-over-year increase. It attributes this growth to higher compensation and benefits due to employee expansion, increased compute and infrastructure costs, and engineering development materials.

children.title: Other Income & Expense and Income Tax
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 CFO Commentary.pdf/Root/CFO Commentary on First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results/Other Income & Expense and Income Tax
children.summary: This section details the company's Other Income & Expense (OI&E) and Income Tax for the first quarter. It defines GAAP OI&E as including interest income, interest expense, and equity securities gains/losses, while Non-GAAP excludes equity securities gains/losses. Key figures include $540 million in interest income and $15.9 billion in net gains from equity securities. The effective tax rates are reported as 16.6% for GAAP and 16.0% for Non-GAAP.

children.title: Balance Sheet and Cash Flow
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 CFO Commentary.pdf/Root/CFO Commentary on First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results/Balance Sheet and Cash Flow
children.summary: This section details the company's financial position and cash movements. It reports on cash, equivalents, and marketable debt securities totaling $50.3 billion. It also covers accounts receivable ($40.7 billion), inventory ($25.8 billion), and multi-year cloud service commitments ($30.0 billion). Additionally, it describes cash flow from operating activities ($50.3 billion) and shareholder returns via share repurchases and dividends.

children.title: Outlook
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 CFO Commentary.pdf/Root/CFO Commentary on First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results/Outlook
children.summary: The section outlines the financial outlook for the second quarter of fiscal 2027. It projects revenue to be $91.0 billion (plus or minus 2%) and explicitly states that no Data Center compute revenue from China is assumed in this forecast. Additionally, it expects GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins to be 74.9% and 75.0%, respectively.

children.title: Non-GAAP Measures
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 CFO Commentary.pdf/Root/CFO Commentary on First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results/Non-GAAP Measures
children.summary: This section defines NVIDIA's non-GAAP financial measures, which are used to supplement GAAP results. It details the components of these measures (e.g., gross profit, operating income, net income) and explains that they are reconciled from GAAP figures by excluding items like acquisition-related costs, gains/losses from equity securities, and stock-based compensation. The section also includes tables reconciling historical GAAP to non-GAAP financials for three quarters and provides a reconciliation of the Q2 FY2027 outlook.
